name: Look Better
lines: /run local c=C_CVar local d=c.GetCVar("groundEffectDensity")=="256" c.SetCVar("groundEffectDensity",d and 48 or 256) c.SetCVar("groundEffectDist",d and 320 or 500) c.SetCVar("GroundEffectFade",d and 70 or 370)

name: Smart Mount
lines: /cast [nocombat,flyable] Cerulean Prideclaw; [nocombat] Veteran Adventurer's Loyal Companion
note: Your two account mounts. If the Prideclaw is not your flyer once flying unlocks, swap the two names. Out of combat only, so it never dismounts you mid-fight.

name: Set Focus
note: Focus your mouseover target, or your current target if the mouse is empty. Alt clears your focus. Most focus macros on this tab feed off this button.

name: Assist
note: Target whatever your focus is hitting (the tank, usually) and start swinging. No focus? Assists your current target instead.

name: Eat & Drink
note: Eats and drinks at the same time, out of combat. Swap the food and drink names for whatever is in your bags - these two are what Skyrinis is carrying.

name: Skull Marker
note: Puts a skull on your target. Works in a party or raid with assist. Change the 8 for other marks: 1 Star, 2 Circle, 3 Diamond, 4 Triangle, 5 Moon, 6 Square, 7 Cross.

name: Bandage Self
note: Bandages you without dropping your target. Update the bandage name as your First Aid climbs (Heavy Linen, Wool, and so on).

name: Mouseover: Healing Wave
note: Restoration. Heals whoever your mouse is over; falls back to your target, then the game's default. This one template covers every heal below - one button each.

name: Mouseover: Chain Heal
note: Restoration. Aim Chain Heal by hovering the player you want it to start on - it still jumps from there.

name: Mouseover: Lesser Healing Wave
note: Restoration. The fast, expensive heal, on mouseover for emergencies.

name: Nature's Swiftness + Healing Wave
note: Restoration. The oh-no button: stops your current cast and fires an instant full Healing Wave at your mouseover or target.

name: Earth Shield (Tank)
note: Restoration. Keeps Earth Shield on your focus (set it to the tank with the Set Focus macro); mouseover wins if you are hovering someone.

name: Wind Shear (Interrupt)
note: Both specs. Stops your cast and interrupts your focus first, then mouseover, then target. Wind Shear is off the global cooldown, so this never wastes the press.

name: Purge
note: Both specs. Strips a buff from focus, mouseover, or target - magic buffs on enemy healers and casters first.

name: Mouseover: Cleanse Spirit
note: Restoration. Cleanse curses, diseases, and poisons by hovering the afflicted player. If your cleanse goes by another name in your book, swap the spell name.

name: Hex (Focus CC)
note: Sets your mouseover as focus if you need one, then Hexes the focus - so you keep DPS or healing on your main target while the frog stays put. Alt clears a stale focus.

name: One-Button Totems + Recall
lines: /castsequence [mod:alt] reset=5 Tremor Totem, Grounding Totem, Earthbind Totem
/castsequence reset=5 Strength of Earth Totem, Windfury Totem, Mana Spring Totem, Searing Totem
note: Press repeatedly to lay the set: Strength of Earth, Windfury, Mana Spring, Searing. Hold Alt for the defensive set (Tremor, Grounding, Earthbind). Shift recalls everything for the mana refund. Swap totem names to taste - Resto may want Healing Stream in the water slot.

name: Weapon Imbues (One Button)
lines: /cast [mod:alt] Earthliving Weapon; [mod:shift] Flametongue Weapon; Windfury Weapon
note: Applies to the main hand (press again after swapping weapons for the off hand). Plain press: Windfury (Enhancement). Shift: Flametongue - your spellhancer imbue. Alt: Earthliving (Restoration).

name: Stormstrike + Swing
note: Enhancement. Guarantees your auto-attacks are running even when Stormstrike is on cooldown - no more standing around mid-fight.

name: Shock Button
note: Enhancement. Flame Shock to keep the dot rolling; hold Shift for Earth Shock to spend the Stormstrike nature buff. Shared shock cooldown, one button.

name: Maelstrom Bolt
note: Enhancement. Fire this at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks; the /startattack line keeps your melee swings going after the cast. For packs, plain Chain Lightning does the same job - this one is the single-target spender.

name: Spell Downranking (EZ)
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted. Shift casts cheap Rank 1 to tag or finish; plain press casts Rank 2.

name: All In 1 Travel Forms (EZ)
lines: /cast [swimming] Aquatic Form;[outdoors] Travel Form; Cat Form
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted.

name: EZ Maul Autos
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted. Bear form rage dump that keeps auto-attacks running.

name: Spell Downranking (EZ)
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted. Shift casts cheap Rank 1 to tag or finish; plain press casts Rank 2.

name: All In 1 Travel Forms (EZ)
lines: /cast [swimming] Aquatic Form;[outdoors] Travel Form; Cat Form
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted.

name: EZ Maul Autos
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted. Bear form rage dump that keeps auto-attacks running.

name: Gathering Toggle (EZ)
note: From the Launch EZ Macros set you saved on Oct 23 - preserved exactly as pasted. Yours alone on the roster, Skyrinis - the only character running both Herbalism and Mining. Each press flips the minimap tracking.

name: Mouseover: Rejuvenation
note: HoT on mouseover - the bread and butter. Works for both druids in either spec.

name: Mouseover: Regrowth
note: Direct heal plus HoT, on mouseover.

name: Mouseover: Lifebloom
note: Stack and roll Lifebloom on the tank by hovering their frame.

name: Mouseover: Healing Touch
note: The big slow heal, on mouseover.

name: Mouseover: Swiftmend
note: Needs a Rejuvenation or Regrowth ticking on the target to work - hover, press, instant rescue.

name: Nature's Swiftness + Healing Touch
note: The druid oh-no button: instant Healing Touch on your mouseover or target.

name: Innervate
note: Focus first (set it to your healer partner or the tank's healer), mouseover second. Alt forces it onto yourself.

name: Mouseover: Rebirth
note: Combat resurrection by hovering the fallen ally's frame or corpse. Note the [dead] check - this one only fires on the dead, as it should.

name: Cyclone (Focus/Mouseover)
note: Cyclone your focus to keep a caster out of the fight, or mouseover to improvise.

name: Mouseover: Entangling Roots
note: Root runners and adds without dropping your target - made for kiting and for Healkin-style solo control.

name: Powershift (Escape)
note: Breaks roots and snares by shifting out and straight back in. The classic druid escape - spam it while running for the door.

name: Bear Emergency
note: One press: Barkskin, into bear, Frenzied Regeneration if you are already bear. When you learn Dire Bear Form, swap the name in. (Form 1 is Bear in the stance bar.)

name: Mouseover: Moonfire
note: Balance / Healkin. Dot adds by hovering nameplates; keeps your main target locked.

name: Dash Cycle (Cat Form)
lines: /castsequence [nomod:shift] reset=15 Cat Form, Dash, Cat Form
note: Cody's Dash cycle (2026-11-11): press for Cat Form, press again for Dash, press a third time once Dash ends to drop back to caster form. Shift+press drops form immediately. Leaving Cat Form ends Dash, so time the exit press yourself.

name: Prowl Cycle (Cat Form Stealth)
lines: /castsequence [nomod:shift] reset=10 Cat Form, Prowl, Cat Form
note: The stealth twin of the Dash cycle (2026-11-11): press for Cat Form, press again for Prowl, press a third time to drop stealth and form and return to caster form. Shift+press drops form immediately. Prowl only works out of combat.

name: Cat Opener
note: Adventurer spec solo work: out of combat it slips you into Prowl, stealthed it Pounces, in the open it Shreds. One button for the whole cat approach.

name: Dash Cycle (Cat Form)
lines: /castsequence [nomod:shift] reset=15 Cat Form, Dash, Cat Form
note: Cody's Dash cycle (2026-11-11): press for Cat Form, press again for Dash, press a third time once Dash ends to drop back to caster form. Shift+press drops form immediately. Leaving Cat Form ends Dash, so time the exit press yourself.

name: Mouseover: Corruption
note: Affliction. Multi-dot by hovering nameplates - your main target never changes.

name: Mouseover: Unstable Affliction
note: Affliction. Same pattern for UA once it is in your book - pair it with Corruption on every extra target.

name: Curse Wheel
lines: /cast [mod:ctrl] Curse of the Elements; [mod:shift] Curse of Tongues; [mod:alt] Curse of Weakness; Curse of Agony
note: One button, every curse: plain press Agony (your DPS curse), Ctrl Elements for the raid, Shift Tongues for casters, Alt Weakness for hard hitters.

name: Drain Soul (No-Clip)
note: Execute and shard farming. Spammable - it will not restart the channel and clip your ticks, and it respects your mouseover for finishing adds.

name: All Drains, One Button
lines: /cast [mod:ctrl,nochanneling:Drain Mana] Drain Mana; [mod:alt,nochanneling:Drain Life] Drain Life; [nochanneling:Drain Soul] Drain Soul
note: Plain press Drain Soul, Alt Drain Life, Ctrl Drain Mana - all with the no-clip protection, so none of them restart mid-channel.

name: Pet Attack + Shadow Bolt
note: Sends the demon in and opens fire on the same target - mouseover if you are hovering one. Your demon is half your damage; this keeps it working the right mob.

name: Pet Control
note: Plain press: pet attacks your target. Shift: pet follows. Alt: pet goes passive. One button for the whole leash.

name: Fear (Focus CC)
note: Same shape as the Hex and Polymorph macros: keeps a focus Feared while you dot your real target. Alt clears a stale focus.

name: Banish (Focus/Mouseover)
note: For demons and elementals - focus first, mouseover second, target last.

name: Armor Toggle
note: Plain press Fel Armor; Shift for Demon Armor when you are taking hits. (If only one armor exists in your book, the other branch simply does nothing.)

name: Soulstone (Mouseover)
note: Uses your pre-made Soulstone on whoever you hover - the healer, ideally, before the pull. Swap 'Master Soulstone' for whatever rank of stone you are currently making.

name: Polymorph (Focus Keeper)
note: The classic sheep keeper: it focuses your mouseover (or keeps a good focus), then Polymorphs the focus - so you keep blasting your real target while the sheep stays sheeped.

name: Counterspell (Interrupt)
note: Stops your cast and silences focus, mouseover, or target. The healer never finishes that heal.

name: Spellsteal / Remove Curse
lines: /cast [@mouseover,help,nodead] Remove Curse; [@mouseover,harm,nodead] Spellsteal; [harm] Spellsteal; Remove Curse
note: One smart button: hover an ally to decurse them, hover an enemy to steal their buff, target an enemy to steal, otherwise decurse your target or yourself.

name: Ice Block (Safe)
note: Stops everything and blocks. Deliberately NOT a toggle - pair it with the cancel macro below so a panicked double-tap never drops your block early.

name: Cancel Ice Block
note: Drops Ice Block on purpose, when YOU decide. Put it somewhere you will not fat-finger.

name: Mouseover: Living Bomb
note: Fire dual spec. Spread Living Bomb across a pack by sweeping your mouse over nameplates.

name: Combustion Burst
note: Fire dual spec. Combustion plus both trinket slots (empty slots just do nothing), straight into Pyroblast - made for Hot Streak windows. If you run no trinkets, the /use lines are harmless.

name: Buffs & Armor (One Button)
lines: /cast [mod:ctrl] Arcane Brilliance; [mod:alt,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:alt] Arcane Intellect; [mod:shift] Molten Armor; Mage Armor
note: Plain press: Mage Armor (your Frostfire sustain). Shift: Molten Armor for Fire crit. Alt: Arcane Intellect on mouseover or target. Ctrl: Arcane Brilliance for the whole group.

name: Teleport / Portal
lines: /cast [mod:alt] Portal: Stormwind; [mod:shift] Teleport: Ironforge; Teleport: Stormwind
note: Plain press teleports you home to Stormwind, Shift goes to Ironforge, Alt opens a Stormwind portal for the group. Swap the cities as you learn more of them.

name: Ice Barrier / Cold Snap
note: Frostfire main. Plain press refreshes Ice Barrier. If it is on cooldown and you need it NOW, Shift fires Cold Snap to reset it - press again right after for the fresh barrier. This is the button your build was made for.

name: Flamestrike (Sticky Targeting)
note: The ! keeps the targeting circle from cancelling itself if you click the button again - mash-friendly ground AoE.
